{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check if revenue column contains thousands separators
print("First few revenue values:", df['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Confirm the format is string with commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).any()
print(f"Revenue contains commas: {has_commas}")

# Attempt to parse revenue after removing commas
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify the parsing worked
print("Sample cleaned revenue:", df['revenue_clean'].head().tolist())"}
